paragraph: Freddie Nole waits at the prison gates so that no one has to walk out alone. He is part of a project called JoyDrops, which spotlights documentary shorts about joy. The Good News Network partnered with this group to share these films and talk with the filmmakers. Freddie says the experience of meeting people never gets old. He means it is a moment that stays with him.
